description:
Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
When Bulwark Ox dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bulwark Ox ability
Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
